Title:Counting Round Numbers in Survey Answers

Authors:Ada Moss, Wei Lin
View a PDF of the paper titled Counting Round Numbers in Survey Answers, by Ada Moss and 1 other author
View PDF
Abstract:Survey answers bunch at round numbers. We measure the bunching in three household surveys and propose a correction that spreads each round answer over its neighbours.
